I'm compelled to explain why this particular update took an unusually long time to be released.

The TL;DR of it is that I had been suffering from a debilitating mental depression from an unclear physical cause, which I believe I have now overcome after many lifestyle changes/experiments.

I feel inclined to apologize profusely to everyone who has supported the project to date, even if in retrospect, the depression turned out to be outside of my immediate control.

I have been a powerhouse of work and motivation for these past two weeks and am very hopeful that I'll be able to continue at this pace!

I'm very sorry that I left you all waiting so long for new content and fixes to Venture Seas. Moving forward, I'm genuinely excited to be working at my maximum ability/enjoyment again!

notes.title: Venture Seas - Announcement + Beta Branch Update 06/06/2020
notes.notes:
The Beta Branch for Venture Seas has updated with fixes and minor additions! (See the changelog below)

Additionally, I wish to announce a change to our development roadmap due to the increasing negative criticism from steam reviews (opinions of which we agree with)

After polling the community, we have decided to postpone the addition of new main story content, so that we can switch focus to improving the core gameplay loop and existing content (as well as add 'missing' side content)

There is no point for us to focus on the new story content when the game is unenjoyable in its current state. So our top priority is now to focus on making the game comfortable and fun to experience:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36210911/690a8a50088a81600c406f60305c703d62a4439f.jpg



We'd perform a general 'tune-up' on the game, which includes:
 Eradicating all reported bugs and issues.
 Balancing Gameplay.
 Improving Gameplay Systems & Mechanics.
 Intuitive Tutorials.
 Replacing some outdated art.
 Improving existing scenes.
 Making sexual content more easily accessible & repeatable.
 Including more character interactions, romance improvements and flavorful scenes.



We want to bring the entire game up to the highest standard we can for you guys at a sensible pace.

There is a 'beta' branch to test out unstable changes before pushing that build over to the default branch.

It is highly recommended that you DO NOT switch to the beta branch if you want the most stable gameplay experience (less chance of crashes / major issues)

If you are interested in testing the latest beta versions, you can now opt-in!
(right-click game in library > VentureSeas > Properties > Betas)
